caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt with a geometric, hexagonal pattern. The main section of the composition fills the lower right portion of the image with rows of multicolored hexagon-based floral motifs. These hexagons are composed of different patterned sections in shades of blue, pink, yellow, green, brown, white, red, purple, and beige, with some containing grid or dotted textures. The space between the hexagons is filled with a beige or off-white color. The quilt is bordered by a thick brown band, itself decorated with a repeating hexagon outline. In the upper left corner, there is an inset showing a simplified line drawing of the central part of the quilt, rendered in brown ink on a tan background, displaying only the outlines and arrangement of the hexagons, without color or pattern fill. The bottom left corner of the image contains two lines of text: “F.S.14” and “E. Valentine.” The rest of the background is plain and light tan in color.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
